goal: Explain and validate the five physical branch currents of the approved bridge circuit using two independent KCL equations and three KVL equations, reduce to three unknowns, solve with MATLAB, and interpret all currents.

deck_context.source_summary: Optional PHY4605 worked example using five physical branch currents for the lecturer-approved 24 V nine-resistor bridge circuit.
canonical_terms: I1–I5 are PHYSICAL BRANCH CURRENTS. Do not introduce mesh currents.
A is upper interior junction, B lower interior junction, C lower-right junction.

I1 enters A from left through R1 and leaves B leftwards through R4 and source; I2 A to B downward through R7; I3 A to C down-right through Rb; I4 A to C through R2,R3,R8 rightward then downward; I5 C to B leftwards through R6,R5.

circuit.source: Vs=24 V, + at top, − at bottom
circuit.topology: Source left vertical. R1 upper-left into A. R4 lower-left from B. R7 vertical A-B. Rb diagonal A-C. R2 then R3 upper series from A, R8 right vertical to C. R5 then R6 lower series from B to C.

deck_context.verification: Fresh MATLAB batch and independent nodal analysis agree. VA=16.5 V, VB=7.5 V, VC=13.5 V vs source negative. Power 60 W. Max reduced residual 1.33e-15 V.
